functional_rationale: Shuyukunapa tantachiy is an authored image-grouping category made from documented image + plural/genitive and the independently documented grouping/union noun. It is not claimed an established software project/assembly term. This category restricts the already supported work noun to the editable grouping, distinct from the PNG output diagnostics.

The work contains original-image references, crop/placement/normalization metadata and not merely a flattened picture. Naming the editable grouping as work retains this scope without substituting a generic draft noun. No temporary or unfinished restriction.

The source-image failure identifies one constituent image, not all images, the whole grouping, or a missing project.json. The exact guard includes a path outside the permitted assembly directory as well as a non-file; absent is relative to the valid expected source set, not a claim someone deleted the source.

Saved work in the opening error describes the existing stored grouping category; it does not assert that this attempt successfully saved, that every file is intact, or that reopening failed before all state was parsed.

review_questions: Does own grouping/union noun with image genitive describe the editable grouping, not just a collection of flattened pictures?
Is repeated category plus saved work a clear distinction from flattened PNG output without needing the English feature label?
Does one image absent remain correctly scoped for a missing/invalid-location source and avoid implying all source data is gone?
Check genitive/plural and saved-work modifier order, current-tree absence and exact raw attrs/slots.
limits: Moderate national Ecuador Kichwa composition only; no exclusive Chimborazo, native-speaker, layout or runtime certification.
Not a blanket generic project or draft noun approval. No application-source edits or tests.
